reason: I already pay for Calm and fall asleep to it with my earphones in every night, and on a student budget I'm not paying for a second sleep app. I might poke at the free trial since there's no auto-charge, but I'd probably forget the morning check-ins and just go back to what I'm used to.
objection: Checking in every morning sounds like homework, and the main thing it does differently, picking the sound back up when I wake, is just one button. I don't see why that's worth another 4,900 won on top of Calm.
would_change_my_mind: If it replaced Calm outright with a sound library just as big, for about the same or less, so I could cancel the other one instead of paying for both.
